title: Maxx Crosby to Fernando Mendoza: You'll never go wrong by remaining genuine

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Maxx Crosby to Fernando Mendoza: You'll never go wrong by remaining genuine
sources.description: Raiders quarterback Fernando Mendoza may not be the starter in Las Vegas right away, but the first overall pick in this year's draft will get there soon enough and he's getting some advice from veteran teammates about how to prepare for the leadership aspects of the role.
